title: Login grants access to the protected company list
description: Verifies a user can sign in, land in the authenticated app shell, and reach the protected company list using the current navigation model.

steps.description: After login, open the protected company list by using the visible Companies navigation item when present, or by navigating directly to /companies
Verify the protected company listing page is displayed

title: Registration redirects to login and the new account can sign in
description: Verifies the current registration contract: account creation redirects to /login?registered=true, shows the registration-success message, and the new user can then sign in and open a protected page.

steps.description: Fill a unique email into the email field
Fill a valid password into the password field
Verify /login?registered=true is shown with the registration-success message
Sign in with the newly registered email and password
Verify the company list page is displayed

title: Inspect inbox and submit an approval decision when one is pending
description: Verifies the current inbox page renders its backend-owned approval posture. If a pending approval exists, submit Approve or Reject; otherwise verify the empty pending-inbox state.
category: Prompt, Credential, Approval, and Memory Management

steps.description: Inspect the current pending approval, if one exists
Submit Approve or Reject when the selected approval is pending
Verify the inbox posture remains visible or the empty pending-inbox state is shown

title: Edit a prompt and see it reflected in the prompt list
description: Verifies an operator can edit a prompt from its detail view, submit changes, and observe the updated prompt reflected in the prompts list.
category: Prompt, Credential, Approval, and Memory Management

steps.description: Open the first prompt from the list
Fill "Updated prompt content - TC001" into the prompt content field
Verify the prompts list shows a prompt with content "Updated prompt content - TC001"

title: Inspect memory observations without editing backend-owned records
description: Verifies the current memory UI is an inspection surface for backend-owned observations. It should render the observation ledger and detail panel without exposing tag or metadata edit controls.
category: Prompt, Credential, Approval, and Memory Management

steps.description: Open the first memory observation from the list
Open the first memory observation from the list when one exists
Verify the observation detail displays captured content and no editable tags/metadata fields

title: Inspect credential management and OAuth actions
description: Verifies the current credentials page renders credential management, OAuth integration status, and either credential cards or the empty state. The UI does not expose credential metadata editing.
category: Prompt, Credential, Approval, and Memory Management

steps.description: Inspect the rendered credential list or empty state
Verify OAuth integrations and connection checklist content are displayed

title: View onboarding progress controls
description: Verifies the current onboarding page renders backend-driven progress controls and labels. The test does not assume an incomplete milestone exists because seeded data may already be complete.

steps.description: Verify the onboarding checklist progress and label are visible

title: Access billing page from admin landing and view plan information
description: Verifies an org admin can navigate from the admin landing page to billing and see billing or plan information rendered.

steps.description: Click the navigation control to open billing
Verify billing and plan information is displayed

title: View workspace access and members from admin area
description: Verifies an admin can navigate to Workspace Access and see workspace details and a members list rendered.

steps.description: Click the navigation control to open Workspace Access
Verify workspace access details and members are displayed

title: Navigate between LLM analytics and memory analytics dashboards
description: Verifies a user can view the LLM analytics dashboard, navigate to memory analytics, and see charts/metrics rendered on both pages.

steps.description: Click the navigation control to view memory analytics
Verify LLM usage metrics or charts are displayed and memory usage metrics or charts are displayed after navigation

title: Memory observation detail remains inspect-only
description: Verifies the current memory observation detail does not expose editable tag or metadata inputs, so invalid tag-saving is not a valid UI flow.
category: Prompt, Credential, Approval, and Memory Management

steps.description: Open the first memory observation from the list
Verify no editable tag or metadata inputs are present

title: Review audit logs entries from admin area
description: Verifies an org admin can navigate to the audit logs page and see a table or list of audit entries rendered.

steps.description: Click the navigation control to open audit logs
Verify recent audit entries are displayed

title: Invalid login shows credential validation error
description: Verifies submitting incorrect credentials does not authenticate the user and shows an invalid-credentials error state.

steps.description: Fill invalid-user@example.com into the email field
Fill wrong-password into the password field
Verify a login validation error is visible

title: View empty-state handling for prompts when no items are available
description: Verifies that the prompts page renders a clear empty state when there are no prompts to display.
category: Prompt, Credential, Approval, and Memory Management

steps.description: Apply available filters or search to restrict results to none
Verify an empty state is displayed for the prompts list

title: Inspect operations diagnostics page renders operational controls
description: Verifies an org admin can open the operations page and see operational controls or diagnostics content rendered.

steps.description: Click the navigation control to open operations
Verify operational controls or diagnostics content is displayed

title: Inspect marketplace administration page renders packages and controls
description: Verifies an org admin can open the marketplace admin page and see marketplace packages and administration controls rendered.

steps.description: Click the navigation control to open marketplace
Verify marketplace packages or administration controls are displayed

title: Inspect SSO settings page displays configuration status (without performing SSO login)
description: Verifies an org admin can open the SSO admin page and view SSO configuration and status information.

steps.description: Click the navigation control to open SSO settings
Verify SSO configuration and status information is displayed

title: Open admin help resources page from admin area
description: Verifies an org admin can navigate to the admin help page and see support/help resources rendered.

steps.description: Click the navigation control to open admin help
Verify admin support or help resources are displayed
